TFT18_Murkwolf._source: Formula correction reviewed 2026-09-06: the archived MetaTFT ability.footer[1].desc defines leap damage as LeapDamageAD + LeapDamageAP, each scaled once. Its attributeCalcs incorrectly multiplies the already AP-scaled GenericCalc1 by LeapDamageAP again (30 x 30 at 2 stars). Use the footer's additive AD/AP formula; retain both source curves. Source: https://data.metatft.com/lookups/TFTSet18_latest_en_us.json (TFT18_Murkwolf). Independently corroborated by https://www.tftraits.com/champions/murkwolf/; live runtime formula is not exposed in the archived character bin.
